value.rationale: Exact fixed-ring type frequencies are natural, nontrivial invariants of all unital algebra endomorphisms, not only invertible group order. The field-size threshold q=2 is sharp and is linked to the determinant acting on the socle. The census also distinguishes the full endomorphism monoid from the automorphism group and yields a global invariant-ring jump and a closed orbit count; these have direct relevance to modular monomial-algebra invariant theory.
